context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the useCart SWR hook from @vercel/commerce-commercejs to retrieve and display the shopping cart. It assesses whether the implementation properly consumes the hook, handles the isEmpty computed property, and correctly handles loading and empty states.

checklist.name: useCart hook usage
checklist.description: The useCart hook is imported from @vercel/commerce-commercejs and called without arguments to retrieve cart state

checklist.name: isEmpty property
checklist.description: The component uses the isEmpty property returned by useCart (not manually computing cart length) to determine if the cart is empty

checklist.name: Loading state
checklist.description: When useCart returns undefined data (loading), the component renders a loading indicator

checklist.name: Empty cart message
checklist.description: When isEmpty is true, the component renders a message indicating the cart is empty

checklist.name: Line items display
checklist.description: When the cart has items, each line item's name and quantity from cart.lineItems is rendered
